title: Battle of Fushun
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Fushun", at revision 1370110606, opens: "The Battle of Fushun was the first military conflict in the war between the Later Jin dynasty and the Ming dynasty, occurring in 1618 in Fushun. The battle ended in a decisive victory for the Later Jin and resulted in the capture of Fushun and two other nearby fortresses." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q30595429, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "military conflict in Fushun, China". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
